field_requirements.evidence: The request selects an explicit season, but the source response is not an archived preseason snapshot.
Portal identity is a name assembled from the current endpoint; no shared stable portal/usage ID is available.
Origin is read from the current portal record and is not an archived roster state.
A final destination may have been resolved or revised after the preseason cutoff.
The date supports deterministic filtering, but publication and revision timing are not archived.
Usage is a prior-season outcome, but the cross-endpoint name join is not an archived transfer roster join.
Position is supplied by the current portal response and is not timestamped as-of the cutoff.
The response does not provide an archived rating revision history.
Eligibility is not a scholarship indicator in the selected source fields.

snapshot_strategy.integration: Add the snapshot acquisition as a prerequisite to the existing preseason pipeline; do not let live portal endpoints enter model fitting directly.
steps: On or before the configured preseason cutoff, fetch each required portal and prior-usage season response.
Write endpoint, query parameters, retrieval timestamp, record count, and SHA-256 in a sidecar.
Never overwrite a prior season snapshot; refresh only into a new explicitly named snapshot when source semantics require it.
Run this audit and derive transfer features only from the frozen snapshot, with explicit aliases and fail-closed ambiguous joins.
